headline: Indian IT services showed solid revenue growth in Q2 FY27, led by TCS and HCLTech.
summary: TCS reported ₹73,188 cr revenue with a 24% operating margin and strong deal wins. HCLTech posted 3% QoQ revenue growth and a 21% YoY profit rise, driven by AI sales. Several peers have not yet released results, limiting a full sector view. Overall, revenue growth was broadly positive across the market.

themes.title: AI as a growth driver
themes.detail: Both TCS and HCLTech highlighted AI revenue contributions, with HCLTech noting a 78% YoY jump.

themes.title: Margin stability
themes.detail: Operating margins remained steady for leaders, with TCS at 24% and HCLTech at 18.2%.

leaders.why: Highest revenue and strong 24% operating margin.
Profit growth of 21% YoY and positive AI revenue trends.

laggards.why: Results not yet released, creating uncertainty.
